traits.name: Interference Aura
traits.text:
Enemies within 30 feet must
make a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw every
round to maintain spells that require concentration.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The dragon makes three attacks: one
with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft.,
one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft.,
one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
